description: The design of one builder app for Figma: tokens = the design tokens in the W3C Design Tokens format (color as sRGB with hex, typography in Inter, spacing and radius in px), screens = every screen or page with its id, title, file name and size. With screen (an id from that list): also svg = that screen as an SVG document with editable text in Inter, which pastes into Figma as a frame with text layers (save it as a .svg file or paste it as is; the text is not converted to outlines). The ZIP with all screens, tokens.json and a guide is on the app page (Figma section) and in the CLI: appforshare builder figma <app>. plugin = true when the plan has the AppForShare Figma plugin (auto layout frames, color and text styles; Pro and Team): the person makes a single use export code on the app page and pastes it into the plugin, never through this tool. Needs a design (the app has a spec). Read only. Every plan with an account.

screen.description: Screen id from the screens list (optional): returns its SVG
